subject: sounds
title: Big and little letters
about: Match each letter's big (capital) and little (lowercase) shapes by name: find the big B for b, the little g for G, across the whole alphabet. Using capital letters is NC RF.1.1 (print concepts) and L.1.2 (capitalising I, names and sentence starts), and DIBELS LNF times exactly this mixed-case letter naming.
tip: Say the letter name together, then ask him to find its partner; the pairs that look different (a, b, d, e, g, h, q, r) are the ones to practise.

cards.q: Which one is the big letter b?
cards.sayQ: Which one is the big letter B?
cards.note: Big B and little b are the same letter. b is for bus.
Big D and little d are the same letter. d is for dog.
Big E and little e are the same letter. e is for egg. Capital is another word for big.

Big H and little h are the same letter. h is for hat.

cards.q: Which one is the little letter F?
cards.note: Little f and big F are the same letter. f is for fish.
Little i and big I are the same letter. i is for igloo. Small is another word for little.
Little j and big J are the same letter. j is for jam. Lowercase is another word for little.
